_doc: BLS release calendar, CONFIGURED (bls.gov schedule/ICS/RSS answer Akamai 403 to scripted clients). DATES: OMB 'Schedule of Release Dates for Principal Federal Economic Indicators for 2026' (PFEI), human-transcribed from the rendered PDF page 4 (its text layer is garbled OCR). The PFEI was NOT revised after the late-2025 shutdown and was wrong for Jan-Apr 2026, so only Jul 2026 onward is carried here, where the PFEI and the secondary calendars agree. TIMES: the PFEI states NO time for BLS rows; 08:30 / 10:00 ET are CONFIGURED from agency practice (precision time_configured, never exact). JOLTS is NOT a PFEI indicator: its dates are CONFIGURED from a secondary (republisher) calendar and carry lower confidence. Each row is [release_date_ET, period_label]. Operator procedure: docs/economic-data/RELEASE-SYSTEM.md 'BLS annual import'. After coverage.end every bls:* series reports NO_EXPECTATION until the next year's file is imported.

citations.pfei: OMB PFEI 2026, https://statspolicy.gov/assets/fcsm/files/docs/OMB_pfei_schedule_release_dates_cy2026.pdf (sha256 5d2c16011a816bc527f628c1e20ff781ed309ed5de55c262ba7ba5bb7718c734, PDF ModDate 2025-09-26, server Last-Modified 2026-09-17), page 4 BUREAU OF LABOR STATISTICS; Jul-Dec 2026 rows cross-checked against secondary calendars (agree)
citations.time_0830: time: CONFIGURED agency practice 08:30 ET (not stated in the PFEI; the NY Fed national economic calendar lists these releases at 08:30 ET; BLS's own time statement is on bls.gov, unreachable to scripts)
citations.time_1000: time: CONFIGURED agency practice 10:00 ET (JOLTS; secondary calendars list 10:00 ET)
citations.jolts: date: JOLTS is NOT in the PFEI. Dates CONFIGURED from a secondary republisher's 2026 JOLTS release-calendar page (fetched 2026-09-28; no October 2026 release is scheduled). LOWER CONFIDENCE: re-verify each date from BLS when reachable
